meta.title: Q2 Market Expansion Review
meta.subtitle: Performance, risks, and the case for the Southeast corridor
meta.author: Strategy Office

blocks.text: Q2 expansion outpaced plan in two of three target regions. Revenue reached **$4.2M** against a $3.8M target, driven by mid-market conversion. The Southeast corridor remains the highest-leverage opportunity, but staffing and onboarding capacity are now the binding constraints.

blocks.title: Decision requested
blocks.text: Approve two additional onboarding hires for the Southeast corridor by **August 1** to protect the Q3 pipeline.

blocks.caption: Figure 1. How each region's variance was reviewed this quarter.

blocks.text: Table 1. Regional revenue vs. target, Q2 FY26.

items: Southeast: two anchor logos closed a quarter early, pulling forward ~$380K.
Midwest: steady pipeline conversion; no structural change.
Mountain West: one enterprise deal slipped to Q3; coverage gap after a field departure.

blocks.title: Capacity risk
blocks.text: Onboarding queue is at **19 days** against a 10-day standard. Left unaddressed, this degrades the retention number that currently anchors the expansion case.

items: Approve two Southeast onboarding hires (offer-ready by August 1).
Rebalance one Mountain West field seat to inside coverage for two quarters.
Hold Q3 targets flat; revisit after the September pipeline review.

blocks.text: The constraint has moved from demand to delivery. That is a better problem, but only if we act on it.
